env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# An interpolated operand of a group send ejects to Go that parses,
# builds and prints what the native run prints. Interpolation is
# lowered last, so the ejected send snapshot must collect its edits
# instead of keeping the unlowered interpolation.
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/group_send_ready.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/group_send_ready.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/group_send_ready.out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds and runs with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/group_send_ready.out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/groupsendready

go 1.27
